name: Gästehaus Elfriede
beschreibung: Gästehaus Elfriede in Gerlos is a traditional Tyrolean guesthouse. Located in the heart of Gerlos, the accommodation is situated close to the valley station of the gondola lift. The welcoming atmosphere is shaped by the idyllic rural surroundings and classic Alpine style. Guests can look forward to straightforward, spotless, and functional amenities. The surrounding mountains offer varied hiking and skiing opportunities right from the doorstep. The guesthouse features an on-site restaurant serving hearty regional specialties. Rooms are equipped with private bathroom, toilet, and balcony. Guests also benefit from a ski storage room and free on-site parking.
